body.text:
> Disclaimer: My situation might be rare and opinionated.

I propose to enhance the dashboard with support for multiple GitHub users/orgs which synchronize to the same ATproto account. Currently, when I want to activate synchub for multiple GitHub users/orgs, the dashboard only shows the last authorized account and its repositories. This confused me a little bit as I was unsure if the GitHub app would continue syncing the previous account. 

My suggestion is to show all GitHub users/orgs the currently logged in account has permissions on, which have the GitHub app installed. Repository grouping would be nice for clarity.

The reason is that I have a personal GitHub account for projects I do for myself (personal portfolio, blog, ...) and a dedicated GitHub organization for OS projects I maintain. But since I only have one ATproto account, I would like to sync repositories from both accounts to the same tangled account.

title.text: Add support for multiple GitHub accounts
